newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia MRCB, NSTP, TV3 in consolidation exercise.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia MRCB, NSTP, TV3 in consolidation exercise.

text.p: Malaysian Resources Corp Bhd (MRCB) on Tuesday announced a proposed consolidation exercise that will see the company eventually holding a 82.2 percent stake in private television operator, Sistem Televisyen Malaysia Bhd (TV3).
TV3 will in turn indirectly hold a 43.7 percent stake in publishing group, New Straits Times Press (M) Bhd (NSTP), under the 2.3 billion ringgit exercise.
Currently MRCB, which also proposed to make a bonus issue of one-for-three, owns 45.1 percent of TV3 and 43.7 percent of NSTP.

The three companies said in a joint statement that MRCB would ensure that the listing status of TV3 and NSTP would be retained by placing out an appropriate amount of shares to maintain the public shareholding spread of at least 25 percent.
MRCB had also made arrangements for a standby credit facility to satisfy the full acceptances of the various offers which would be financed by external borrowings.

Under the exercise, MRCB will first transfer its stake in NSTP to its wholly-owned subsidiary MR Marketing Sdn Bhd, which will then be acquired by TV3 for 1.32 billion ringgit. This will be satisfied by the issue of 253.05 million new shares in TV3 at 5.20 ringgit per share.
MRCB will then undertake a general offer for the remaining 111.66 million shares in NSTP not already held by MR Marketing at a cash offer of 15.20 ringgit per share.

MRCB will also make a mandatory general offer for the remaining 93.30 million shares in TV3 not already held by MRCB, and the 16.42 million new shares that may be issued by TV3 if all the outstanding TV3 share options are exercised pursuant to the TV3 employee share option scheme, at an offer price of 5.50 ringgit a share.

If the proposed general offer on NSTP is successful, MRCB will dispose of a minimum of 12.59 million NSTP shares to another wholly-owned unit MR Plantations, to be satisfied by the issuance of new shares in MR Plantations.
TV3 will then acquire a 100 percent equity interest in MR Plantations through the issue of up to 326.41 million new shares at 5.20 ringgit per share.

The companies said the proposed exercise would facilitate the flow of resources between MRCB, TV3 and NSTP to respond to the fast moving media business and enable the two media companies to maximise utilisation of their assets.
The exercise will also convert MRCB's shareholding in TV3 to that of a signficiant subsidiary from that of an associate at present, the statement said.
MRCB's one-for-three bonus issue will involve a total of 240.21 million new shares which will be capitalised from the company's share premium and unappropriated profit accounts.
Shares of MRCB, NSTP and TV3 were suspended on Friday at the companies' requests pending the announcement.
